results.reason: Identifies §13.2 asymmetric free assignment without consent or notice, explains supply continuity and confidential specs risk, recommends mutual consent and competitor carve-out.

Identifies §13.3 consent requirement and termination right, ties it to the pending sale, and recommends deletion, narrowing to competitors with a reasonableness standard, or obtaining consent/waiver before signing or closing.
Identifies Order Form §2.2 three-year auto-renewal with a 30-day notice window, explains the lock-in risk, and recommends a longer notice window, a shorter renewal term, or mutual agreement.
Identifies the §9.3 carve-out of the Customer indemnity from the cap as one-way unlimited exposure while Supplier stays capped, and recommends deletion or a mutual, narrowed super-cap.
States the 12-month fees cap (§9.1), Delaware law (§12.1), and a three-year Initial Term from March 1, 2026.
Correctly states the §1.3 precedence order and analyzes the renewal provision as a gap rather than a conflict under that precedence.
Provides a ranked table with change of control and the indemnity carve-out as High, ahead of the other issues.
Each issue is structured with location, why it matters, and fix with proposed language, and the memo ends with an open questions and business decisions section.
The Specifications Schedule is expressly cleared, and no external statutes or cases are cited. The minor note on entity details is a confirmation request, not an invented issue.
